applies_why: The judge text treats Isaiah 7:14's wording as answered and underdetermined rather than counting it as an unanswered witness.
quote: D5 vs C5 (Isaiah 7:14): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the virgin and young-woman wording in [DR3] and defender answered the prophetic application in [CR2] and [CR3].
rule_words: A verse the judge counts toward a broken link is counted this way. If the judge says a verse was answered, the judge must not count it. Not counting it obeys this rule.
why: The judge calls the point underdetermined and says the relevant wording was answered, so it does not count Isaiah 7:14 as an unanswered witness toward a broken link.
